answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 42 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The lotus register is checked at draw time, knoll lists the eligible set, and raven seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 42 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. The fee repeats 18 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
